title: Apple to Replace iPhone Duo Handsets with Screen Faults
excerpt: Apple has announced plans to replace iPhone Duo handsets following reports of display issues on its first foldable device.
body_html:
Apple has stated that it will replace iPhone Duo handsets that experience screen problems. The announcement follows online photo shares that revealed faults appearing on the displays of the company's inaugural foldable device.

Users who encountered screen issues on the new hardware will be eligible for replacements. Apple has not shared further details regarding the cause of the display faults beyond confirming the replacement policy for affected devices.
